content.short: A premature monument to paper currency.
content.description:
Our old money is economically flawed but they still make incredible NFTs.

The Federal Reserve was created on my watch and now look what it's become. I want us to turn back on our old printing machines so we can inflate the fiat money supply to an all time high ONCE again.

My New Economic Policy was supposed to stop the devaluation of our dollar but all it's done is cause inflation to come back with a vengeance. I won't let another scandal keep us from printing our bills.
